defaultPrompt: Review my website UI/UX and propose a prioritized, evidence-based improvement plan.
Improve the visual design of my portfolio while preserving all existing functionality.
Audit my frontend for accessibility, responsive layout, and interaction problems, then fix the highest-impact issues.
interface.longDescription: A reusable, framework-aware design workflow inspired by the public Impeccable project. Helps coding agents inspect a website, identify UX and visual issues, plan purposeful improvements, implement changes safely, and verify responsive behavior and interactive controls.

name: impeccable-design-workflow
description: A practical UI/UX design workflow for AI coding agents: audit, critique, refine, and creatively improve websites while preserving working behavior.
